description: Look up a named pension plan sponsor's PBGC status: whether a pension plan was terminated and taken over by PBGC ("trusteed") because it was underfunded, or is still an active plan currently paying PBGC premiums (single-employer or multiemployer). Searches both PBGC registers by sponsor name, plan name, and/or employer EIN, and returns data_as_of so the caller knows how current each match is. Answers "did United Airlines' pension plan get taken over by PBGC", "is Acme Corp's pension plan still active", "what happened to the Enron pension plan". Example: pbgc_plan_status({ sponsor: "US Airways" }). Keyless.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / employer name, e.g. "US Airways"

name: pbgc_plan_status
title: Pbgc Plan Status
